#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s RELEASE_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

case $1 in
    /*) release_path=$1 ;;
    *)  release_path=$base/$1 ;;
esac

release_path=$(readlink -f -- "$release_path") || {
    printf 'publish: release directory does not exist: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
}

case $release_path in
    "$base"/releases/*) ;;
    *)
        printf 'publish: release must be staged under %s/releases: %s\n' "$base" "$1" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

if [ ! -d "$release_path" ]; then
    printf 'publish: not a release directory: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$release_path/MANIFEST" ]; then
    printf 'publish: refusing release without MANIFEST: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi

target=${release_path#"$base"/}
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d "$base/.publish.XXXXXX")
cleanup() {
    rm -f -- "$tmpdir/current"
    rmdir -- "$tmpdir" 2>/dev/null || :
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

ln -s -- "$target" "$tmpdir/current"
mv -Tf -- "$tmpdir/current" "$base/current"

trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
rmdir -- "$tmpdir"
